description: This file defines the HTMLPurifier class, which is a core component of the HTML Purifier library responsible for filtering and sanitizing HTML content to ensure it is safe and standards-compliant. It includes methods for purifying individual HTML snippets or arrays of snippets, manages configuration, filters, and the purification process, and implements a singleton pattern.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier
classes.description: A facade class that coordinates the HTML purification process, manages configuration, filters, and singleton instance, and provides methods to purify HTML snippets or arrays of snippets.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the purifier with optional configuration and sets up the core strategy.

methods.name: addFilter
methods.description: Adds a custom filter to the purification process (deprecated method).

methods.name: purify
methods.description: Filters an HTML snippet to be XSS-free and standards-compliant, returning purified HTML.

methods.name: purifyArray
methods.description: Filters an array of HTML snippets, returning an array of purified HTML snippets.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Provides a singleton instance of the HTMLPurifier class, optionally initialized with a prototype.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Backwards compatibility method that returns the singleton instance.
